# `Q-13-3` — Page footer references missing document

> A page-footer entry points at a document that is not in the
> project's render index.

## What this means

The website page footer (rendered at the bottom of every page)
is built from `website.page-footer` entries in `_quarto.yml`.
Each entry that names a document is looked up in the project
index at render time. This error fires when the name does not
appear in that index. The footer still renders, but the entry
has no working link.

## Why this happens

Same family of causes as `Q-13-1` (sidebar missing document):
typo, renamed or deleted document, excluded file, wrong
relative-path base.

## How to fix

Update the footer entry to point at a file that is in the
render set, or add the missing file. The message names the
missing path.

## Related

- `Q-13-1`, `Q-13-2`, `Q-13-4`, `Q-13-7` — same shape of
  diagnostic for sidebar, navbar, body link, and
  page-navigation surfaces respectively.
